intro: Competitor onboarding packages rebuilt in Balance's skin, from welcome to today's paywall, two versions each: the wish list as we'd build it with no template limits, and a constrained version that uses only card templates that exist in the app today. Built Sep 4, 2026 for the Balance top-of-funnel bet.

bases.name: Calmer's package
bases.description: The quiz-funnel genre reference: proof up front, questions in an ask, echo, teach, preview rhythm on every goal path, a named result profile and a progress graph. Built from Alex's talk-over of the Calmer recording.

bases.name: Insight Timer's package
bases.description: The proof-density reference: proof stacked before the first question, interests instead of diagnoses, chart-backed benefit beats, a consecutive-days commitment, a dosage-lowering chart before the minutes ask, a plan built from the answers and a dated outlook. Built from the Insight Timer teardown without a talk-over; unreviewed.
